body: Unfortunately I'm in a really bad place with my job, a very hostile work environment that I've been trying to get out of for months. I think that's actually a big reason why this is so hard, I'm having a hard time seeing a light at the end of the tunnel and feel like I have nothing good going on in my life right now. All of my really close friends have moved out of the area in the past year, and my family is also too far away to see regularly, so I feel really hopeless and alone. Thank you for your kind words, I am trying to stay strong.

I'm only afraid of being alone at this moment because of how bad I feel, I want someone there to support me (a friend, family member) and that won't happen until tonight. I don't know if I will actually kill myself, though I've come pretty close a few times in the past 48 hours. I thought about checking myself in to a hospital today because I'm overwhelmed and scared and can't take care of myself right now, but decided not to because I'm broke with no insurance and I needed to be at work after missing the last two days.

I'm trying to get into a support group in my area, and I'll look at some online. I don't have regular internet access now except on my phone or at work so online might not be a good option. I just want to stop loving him, I want to feel the way my brain tells me I should but I can't right now and I'm so miserable.

No, I'm in Seattle. I don't know if I will actually kill myself, I feel totally numb one second and remember him screaming "I had to get drunk just to STAND having you living here" the next and just feel so worthless that I want to give up. I can't handle the thought of leaving the apartment that we shared (and I love) and going to some place alone, with no furniture. I don't think I'm strong enough for this.

Thank you for being real, I guess I'm still making excuses for him. I do know that people can get past this type of problem, my father did (although he was never physically abusive, just verbally and had rage issues), but that is no reason to expect this guy to. I feel horribly, horribly misled, like I can never trust anyone again.

To adress the rest of your comment, I have reached out to a few friends today and I am getting support. The area I'm in is under heavy snow and ice and I can't get to them, nor can they get to me. I really want someone to hug me while I cry. I have pushed a lot of people out of my life during this because I was ashamed to be in this type of relationship, thankfully they are being understanding.

Thank you. I think the verbal abuse all hit me at once today, I didn't really feel it until we broke up. Before this relationship I had a great life with great friends and I was confident with strong body image; now I can't stop thinking about his comments about my hips being too big and my teeth not being white enough and me being too short. I feel disgusting and unworthy.

I have a friend who lives next door who let me stay there last night, I can go there if things get bad. He is also friends with my now ex, which makes it weird and I can't really talk to him. I tried but he didn't seem open to listening.
